gazulus.name: Johannes Gazulus
gazulus.description: A Dominican astronomer employed on Ragusan diplomatic business. Gazulus measures his words with the care he gives his instruments. He can make a refusal sound final, then quietly identify the small, lawful opening through which something useful might still pass.

cotrugli.name: Benedetto Cotrugli
cotrugli.description: A Ragusan merchant with business across the Mediterranean and close ties to Naples. Cotrugli likes an agreement with names, dates and a captain responsible for the cargo. He enjoys mocking official caution, but relies upon it more than he admits.
